additions.provider: Community GitHub archive of Sleeper /players/nfl payload
additions.mechanism: The repository overwrites nfl/sleeper_data_latest.json daily, while Git commits preserve prior blob versions. Historical state is therefore recoverable by commit timestamp even though the working tree exposes only latest.json.
additions.research_value: Potentially fills the exact 2025 point-in-time status gap that blocked V09B, but only if historical blobs prove field completeness/stability and player IDs can be crosswalked safely.
qualification_needed: audit snapshot continuity around every 2025 regular-season week
measure population/missingness of injury_status and practice_participation by date and position
verify update time precedes each tested T-120 cutoff
crosswalk Sleeper player_id to GSIS with quantified unresolved/duplicate rate
compare a manual sample with contemporaneous official NFL injury reports
review whether using archived API output for non-commercial model research is compatible with Sleeper terms and repository/data rights
additions.current_decision: high-priority source audit; not qualified for model fitting yet

additions.research_value: Stronger historical roster-state spine than season-level rosters. Useful for roster churn and personnel topology; roster status must not be treated as a practice-report injury probability.

additions.current_2026: requires current-season freshness audit before use
additions.research_value: Potential compact QB-quality benchmark that is distinct from LevLine's current PBP QB state, but may overlap heavily and depends on publication/freshness and rights review.
additions.current_decision: P2 schema/freshness audit only; lower priority than NGS because current 2026 publication status is not yet established

additions.research_value: Possible slowly moving talent/investment prior and useful team/player dossier context. Not expected to carry enough orthogonal game-level signal to outrank FTN/NGS research.
additions.rights_note: Derived/model research and public redistribution need separate OverTheCap/nflverse rights review before any public display.

additions.research_value: Useful event/context signal and roster-churn audit, not a standalone forecast feature.
Potential hierarchical prior for low-NFL-sample rookies/young players, especially early season. Must be tested as a compact prior rather than a broad feature fishing exercise.

important_non_candidates: Fantasy rankings/ADP and trending-player popularity are not proposed as football-strength features.
Undocumented ESPN endpoints are not proposed as production dependencies.
Community archives are evidence sources, not automatically trusted authoritative sources.
